name: W Taipei
positioning: A Xinyi District hotel perched atop Taipei City Hall station next to Taipei 101, with an outdoor heated pool and poolside beach, a space-capsule-inspired spa and suites with Taipei 101 views
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right on the MRT next to Taipei 101
Design-minded city travelers who like a lively pool scene and art-filled rooms

facts.text: The hotel's address is 10 Zhongxiao East Road Sec. 5, Xinyi District, Taipei.
The hotel is perched above the Uni department store and the City Hall MRT stop, minutes from Taipei 101.
The poolside beach is set against the Xinyi district with sweeping city views.
The gym is a glass workout space with cardio machines and a Jacuzzi.
The signature W bed has 350-thread-count linens and a goose duvet.
Select suites have views of Taipei 101.
Rooms have a flat-screen TV and a built-in BOSE sound system.
Whatever/Whenever service can arrange requests like VIP box seats at a baseball game or Chinese opera lessons from a master performer.
Seasons by olivier e. on the 10th floor serves modern French cuisine.

highlights.text: The hotel sits atop Taipei City Hall station, next to Taipei 101 and Taipei Dome.
The outdoor heated WET pool is anchored at one end by larger-than-life stainless steel water drop sculptures.
The Extreme WOW Suite is a bi-level two-bedroom suite with panoramic 270-degree views of the city and Taipei 101.
Rooms and suites feature Zodiac-inspired animal sculptures, stainless steel map installations and other artwork.
AWAY Spa is inspired by the design of a space capsule.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, about 4.8 km from the hotel.
The landscaped poolside comes with DJ beats.
WhataHotel notes the trendy atmosphere may not suit travelers who prefer traditional luxury.
